title: Saloon Boat
specs: Private cruises only, no other groups on board
blurb: Guests enjoy private BYOB boat cruises on Lake Erie with a professional captain. Cruises last 2 hours and accommodate up to 16 guests. Music is played through an onboard Bluetooth sound system, and there is a restroom on board.
extraNote: $99 deposit holds your cruise if booked more than two weeks in advance · Balance due two weeks before the trip · Final head count due two days before the cruise · Safe Harbor Marina/Buffalo State Park, park to the right of Charlie’s Boat Yard Restaurant
